### Test the features with our free plan
Sign up for our free plan (no credit card required) to try the features for yourself. Upgrade to a paid plan when you're ready to scale.

Twilio SendGrid pricing comes down to two things: how much email you send each month and which features you need. Plans run from a free 60-day trial to Essentials at $19.95/mo, Pro at $89.95/mo, and custom Premier pricing. Volume discounts kick in as you scale.
Each tier adds more as your program grows:
- Essentials: Core sending, tracking, and deliverability tools for smaller programs
- Pro: Dedicated IPs, subuser management, single sign-on, and email testing
- Premier: Custom volume, more email validations, and expert program management

Twilio SendGrid's free trial runs $0 for 60 days and lets you send 100 emails a day — no credit card, no commitment. You get analytics, deliverability optimization, and the dynamic template editor, so you can test the real platform before committing to a paid plan.
Send past what your plan includes and overage charges may apply on top of your monthly rate. If you're regularly pushing your limit, upgrading to the next tier usually beats paying overages. Check your plan details for the specifics.

title: SendGrid Pricing 2026: Free Trial, Essentials vs Pro, Overage Rates, and How It Compares to Resend

The plan cards and comparison table on Twilio's pricing pages list a Free Trial at $0 for 60 days, sending up to 100 emails a day, with no credit card, one teammate and one event webhook. SendGrid's overage article adds that the trial stores 100 contacts and cannot go over its limits. After 60 days you choose a paid plan.

title: SendGrid Pricing 2026: Essentials, Pro and the Retired Free Plan
snippet:
SendGrid pricing in 2026: Essentials from $19.95 a month for 50,000 emails, Pro from $89.95 for 100,000, a 60-day trial instead of a free plan, and the add-ons.

SendGrid's Email API costs $19.95 a month for 50,000 emails on Essentials, $34.95 for 100,000, and from $89.95 a month on Pro, which runs from 100,000 to 2.5 million emails. Premier is a custom quote. There is no free plan any more: new accounts get a 60-day trial capped at 100 emails a day. Prices read on [Twilio SendGrid's Email API pricing page](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/products/email-api/pricing), October 2026, all billed monthly.

| Plan | Monthly emails | Price per month | Price per 1,000 emails | What it adds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free trial | 100 a day, 60 days | $0 | n/a | Analytics, deliverability tools, dynamic template editor |
| Essentials 50k | 50,000 | $19.95 | $0.40 | Core API and SMTP sending, 2 event webhooks, 1 teammate |
| Essentials 100k | 100,000 | $34.95 | $0.35 | Same features, twice the volume |
| Pro 100k | 100,000 | $89.95 | $0.90 | Dedicated IP, subusers, SSO, 1,000 teammates, 2,500 validations |
| Pro 300k | 300,000 | $249 | $0.83 | Same Pro features |
| Pro 700k | 700,000 | $499 | $0.71 | Same Pro features |
| Pro 1.5M | 1,500,000 | $799 | $0.53 | Same Pro features |
